name: morphing-text
title: Morphing Text
description: Melts one word into the next with a blur and an SVG threshold filter. Screen readers get the whole list once.

props.name: words
props.description: Words to morph through, in order. The last one morphs back into the first.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds each word holds still between morphs.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before the first morph is counted.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
